manifest.title: An existing repository (TypeScript / JavaScript)
manifest.description: A TypeScript / JavaScript repository on GitHub that already works. Start from a folder you cloned yourself and told Claude Code to trust.

state.title: Check the state of the repository
state.description: Checks for a GitHub origin, the gh sign-in, a clean working tree and an up-to-date default branch. Makes sure .blueprint/ is not committed.

baseline.title: Is everything green before any change?
baseline.description: Finds and records the commands for lint, type checking, tests and build, and checks that all of them pass with nothing changed.

ci.title: Does CI run the same checks?
ci.description: Finds out and records whether CI runs the same checks on every PR. Anything missing is added as the first change, after approval.
